notes.title: New character: Vampire

New content:
This patch brings a 6th character, Like the other characters, the Vampire comes with her own set of cards and props!
65 New Cards.
17 New Props.
Added 2 achievements.

notes.title: New Keywords. New Cards. New Props.
notes.content:
New keywords:
Critical X: Has an X% chance to double damage and trigger bonus effects.

Echo: When you play this card, automatically play all cards with the same name in your hand without consuming energy. Targets are chosen randomly.

Star Point X: If this card is the Xth from the left of your hand, an extra effect is triggered.

Combo 1: It needs to be triggered by the Combo 2 effect.

Combo 2: When you play a card with Combo 2 effect, automatically play a random card with Combo 1 effect in your hand without consuming energy. Targets are chosen randomly.

Combo 3: When you play a card with Combo 3 effect, automatically play a random card with Combo 2 effect in your hand without consuming energy. Targets are chosen randomly.

Kicker X: If there is enough energy, an additional X points of energy are consumed to trigger an additional effect.

Skilled X: After playing this card, reduce the Skilled value of this card by 1 this combat. If the Skilled value of this card is equal to 0, trigger this effect.

75 New Cards. 
15 New Props. 

Balance Changes:
Neutral cards:
Six neutral cards have been removed: Throwing Dagger, Arrow Rain, Red Bag, Corrosive Potion, Teeth of Nightmares, Focus.
Chaos Knight:
"The Sting of Death" Add keyword “Combo1”.
"Divine Storm" Add keyword “Combo1”.
"Dark Fire" Add keyword “Combo2”.
"Divine Spear" Add keyword “Combo3”.

UI Optimization.
All monsters now has polished art asset.
Russian language support added.
All known issues are fixed.

We have made a new character and will release an update soon after the test is completed.
With the upcoming full release, there will be a price increase.

notes.title: New Props. New Monsters. New Events.
notes.content:
38 Props
9 Monsters
9 Events

The progress of the game is now saved at the beginning of each turn.
All known issues are fixed.

Balance Changes:
Neutral:
Red Bag: Common -> Rare.

Overdraft: Rare -> Common.

Purify: Costs 0 -> 2.

Rat Tail: This Prop's purpose is unknown.
-> Immune to an attack that kills you. After triggering the effect, lose this prop.

Berserker:
Burst into Anger: Common -> Rare.

Blast Cut: Rare -> Common.

Bloody Strike: Rare -> Common.

Eternal Blood: Common -> Rare.

Exchange: Discard 1 card -> Discard 2 cards.

Constriction: Unplayable. If this card is discarded from your hand, gain 1 energy and draw 1 card.
-> Unplayable. If this card is discarded from your hand, gain 1 energy.

Constriction+: Unplayable. If this card is discarded from your hand, gain 2 energy and draw 2 cards.
-> Unplayable. If this card is discarded from your hand, gain 1 energy and draw 1 card.

Bugmaster:
Total Invasion: Costs 1 -> 2. Damage 2 -> 4.

Prophet:
Catastrophic Impact：
 Deal 5 damage to all enemies in the front row. If your life pile has no cards, it costs 0.
-> Deal 4 damage to all enemies in the front row. Decrease the damage of this card by 1 for every 2 cards in your life pile (rounded down).

Solar Strike: Costs 1 -> 2.

notes.title: New Monsters
notes.content:
3 bosses has been added!
Phantom Master:
After this enemy attacks, summon 2 doppelgangers of it to the front row. When a doppelganger receives damage, it dies.

Dog King:
Engage: Summon a Dog Prince behind this enemy. After this enemy attacks, Dog Prince gains +1 attack power.

Dog Prince:
Range. Agile. Engage: Double this enemy’s attack power.

Phoenix:
After this enemy attacks, it gains +1 attack power. Rebirth. When the Rebirth effect is triggered, this enemy becomes a Fire Phoenix.

Fire Phoenix
This enemy attacks 1 extra time each turn. After this enemy attacks, its loses 1 attack power. If its attack power is 0, it becomes a Phoenix and gains Rebirth.

Balance Changes:

Berserker:
Rip and Tear +:
Deal 2 damage. Draw 2 cards from the target.
－＞Deal 3 damage. Draw 2 cards from the target.

Blood Summoning:
Draw 3 cards from your block pile.
－＞Draw 4 cards from your block pile. then discard 1 card.

Blood Extract:
Deal 4 damage. Put all Boiling Blood cards from the target's body into your hand.
－＞Deal 1 damage to all enemies in the front row. Put all Boiling Blood cards from all targets's body into your hand.

Throw:
Costs 4 -> 3.

Prophet:

Red Giant:
Deal 4 damage to all enemies in the front row. If there are no cards in your life pile, It costs 0.
－＞Deal 5 damage to all enemies in the front row. For every 2 cards in your life pile, decrease the damage of this card by 1.

Wheel of Fortune:
Gain 2 energy, then put this card on top of your life pile.
－＞Draw 3 cards, then put this card on top of your life pile.

Cosmic Storm +:
Costs 5 -> 3.
Cast 6 Attack cards at random from your block pile.
－＞Cast 5 Attack cards at random from your block pile.

 Others: 
30 cards now has polished art asset.
Part of the UI has been redesigned and now has polished art asset.

 Bug fixes: 
Fixed an issue that did not deal 2 damage when casting Death's Passing.
Fixed an issue where clicking the End Turn button too quickly caused few cards to not work properly.
Fixed an issue where Beastmaster had a small chance of getting stuck at the end of your turn by quickly clicking the End Turn button.
Fixed an issue where Saber-Tooth's damage display was not visible when the attack reaches 10.
Fixed an issue where music did not switch properly when reaching the shop.
Fixed an issue that Endless Mode 3rd round, Fanatic always do more than 2 damage and never die.
Fixed an issue where the Monster Heart did not gain 2 more energy if the cards were shuffled at the start of your turn.

notes.title: V0.9 New character: Beastmaster
notes.content:
New content:
This patch brings a 5th character, new cards, props and achievements!
New character: Beastmaster.            
Added 8 props.            
Added 2 achievements.

UI Optimization:
Changed the event UI.
The top right corner of the Attack card shows the damage value.
Added some VFX, changed the VFX of some cards.

Balance Changes:
The chances for legendary cards and rare cards to appear has slightly increased.

Berserker:
Rip and Tear +: 
    Deal 3 damage. Draw 1 cards from the target.
->Deal 2 damage. Draw 2 cards from the target.

Burst into Anger: 
    Discard 1 card from your hand. Add 2 Boiling Blood cards into your hand.
->Discard 1 card from your hand. Add 3 Boiling Blood cards into your hand.

Bugmaster:
Shiv: Damage 8 -> 6
Sample Selection: Cost: 3 -> 4

Prophet:
Foresee the Future: Cost: 2 -> 3, Damage: 4 -> 6
Solar Flare: Cost: 2 -> 3, Damage: 4 -> 6

Chaos Knight:
Convict: Cost: 1 -> 2, Damage: 2 -> 3
Chaos Punisher: Cost: 0 -> 1

prop:
Plate Armor: 
    Reduce all damage taken to 6.
->Non-boss enemies cannot deal more than 4 damage to you.

Skeleton Ring: 
    At the end of your turn, 2 random cards are reserved in your hand.
->At the end of your turn, keep 2 random non-Curse cards in your hand.

Monster:
Ant Queen: 
   Frontline: As long as an Soldier Ant is on the field, this enemy is immune to all damage.
->Frontline: As long as an Soldier Ant is on the field, this enemy has IronDefense.

Strong Rat Men: 
   Engage: Immune to all damage this turn.
->Engage: This enemy gains IronDefense for this turn.

Adult Bird Lizard:
   Rebirth. When the Rebirth effect is triggered, immune to all damage this turn.
->Rebirth. When the Rebirth effect is triggered, this enemy gains IronDefense for this turn.


Event:
Soul. Burn some money: 
    Pay 2 gold coins and gear rare gear with a certain probability.
->Pay 10 gold coins and get 1 random rare prop.

Lizard Witch. Drink strange potion:
    Gain 5 energy points.
->All Attack cards gain 1 additional damage for this combat.

Score:
Highest grade: 2 points for each level -> 5 points for each level.
Minimalist: Your deck is less than or equal to 10 cards: 100->200
Anemic: Your deck is less than or equal to 20 cards: 80->150
Crisp skin: Your deck is less than or equal to 30 cards: 60->100
Concentrated: Your deck is less than or equal to 40 cards: 40->50
Plain and true: There are no legendary cards in your deck: 50->100
Maximum continuous kill: The highest record of destroying enemies in a turn: 
5 points for each enemy -> 20 points for each enemy

notes.title: V0.8.3 Balance Changes. UI Optimization.
notes.content:
Cards

Neutral:

Purify:
Choose a card in your hand. Remove the chosen card from your deck, then draw 3 cards.
-> Choose a card in your hand. Remove the chosen card from your deck, then draw 4 cards.

Weak Potion:
Decrease the attack power of the target enemy by 2 this turn. 
-> Decrease the attack power of the target enemy by 3 this turn. 

Berserker:

Exchange:
Discard 2 cards, Gain 2 energy.
-> Discard 1 card, Gain 2 energy.
Exchange+:
Discard 1 card, Gain 2 energy.
-> Discard 1 card, Gain 3 energy.

Go Ballistic:
Unplayable. If this card is discarded from your hand, add 2 Boiling Blood cards into your hand.
-> Unplayable. If this card is discarded from your hand, add 3 Boiling Blood cards into your hand.

Bugmaster:

Burst: Costs 1 -> 3. 
Deal damage equal to the number of Parasitic cards in the target's body.
-> Deal damage equal to the number of cards in the target's body.

Behavioral Unification: Costs 2 -> 1. 
Behavioral Unification +:
For this turn, whenever you would deal 3 or less attack damage, increase it to 4.
-> For this turn, whenever you would deal 4 or less attack damage, increase it to 5.

Call Together:
Choose a card in your block pile. Put all cards from your life pile and block pile with that name into your hand.
-> Choose a card in your life pile. Put all cards from your life pile and block pile with that name into your hand.

Prophet:

Little Dipper: Costs 1 -> 2. Damage: 2 -> 4.
Spiritual Oppression: Costs 4 -> 5.  Damage: 6 -> 8.

Chaos Knight:

Horrify: Costs 2 -> 3.
Divine Hand: Costs 2 -> 1. Damage: 4 -> 2.
Shadow Sword: Damage: 4 -> 3.
Shield Bash: 
Deal 2 damage. Pray: Draw 3 non-Curse cards.
 -> Deal 2 damage. Pray: Draw 2 non-Curse cards.

Props

Neutral

Red Flower:
Every time you kill 8 enemies, gain 1 energy.
 -> Every time you kill 6 enemies, gain 1 energy.

Blue Flower:
Every time you play 10 cards, draw 1 card.
 -> Every time you play 10 cards, draw 2 cards.

Twig:
Every time you kill an elite enemy, gain 4 experience points.
 -> Every time you kill an elite enemy, gain 6 experience points.

Crimson Feather:
Every time you skip a card reward or prop reward, you gain an extra 5 gold.
 -> Every time you skip a card reward or prop reward, you gain an extra 10 gold.

Meditation Ring:
Whenever you play a card that costs 4 or more, gain 1 energy.
-> Whenever you play a card that costs 3 or more, gain 1 energy.

Berserker:

Ox Horn:
If you have only 1 card in your hand, that card costs 1 less energy.
 -> If you have only 1 card in your hand, that card costs 2 less energy.

Prophet:

Astral Dice:
Whenever you Foresee, deal 2 damage to a random enemy in the front row.
 -> Whenever you Foresee, deal 3 damage to a random enemy in the front row.

Dark Moon Staff:
Every time you Cast 5 cards, gain 1 energy.
 -> Every time you Cast 3 cards, gain 1 energy.

Astrology Book:
If you have no cards in your life pile, increase the damage of all Attack cards by 1.
 -> If you have no cards in your life pile, increase the damage of all Attack cards by 2.

Monster

Blood Hand：
HP: 7 -> 14
Range. Agile. Rebirth. Iron Defense -> Range. Agile. Rebirth.

Event

Strong Rat Men:
Open small package: Gain 50 gold coins. -> Gain 30 gold coins.

Musketeers:
Help shoot: Kill a non-boss enemy at random. -> Kill all non-boss enemies.

Orc Robber:
Loot the body of the Orc Robber: Gain 100 gold coins and add 2 Wound cards into your life pile. -> Gain 80 gold coins and add 1 Wound card into your life pile.
Search the body of the Orc Robber: Get 2 random props, and add 4 Wound cards into your life pile. -> Get 2 random props, and add 2 Wound cards into your life pile.

Phantom:
Suppress: Draw 2 cards, and the cost becomes 0. -> Draw 4 cards, and the cost becomes 0.

Mysterious Old Man:
Ring the bell: The attack power of all non-boss enemies on the field becomes 1. -> The attack power of all non-boss enemies on the field becomes 0.
Play flute: destroy all non-boss enemies in the middle row. -> Destroy all non-boss enemies.

Hemoptysis Bat:
Blood for blood: Remove 5 cards and get 5 card picks. -> Remove 1 prop and get 3 card picks.

Bug Fixes:

notes.title: V0.7.4 Balance Changes, UI Optimization
notes.content:
Balance Changes
Arrow Rain +: Costs-1, Damage-1.

Heavy Blow: Costs 5->3, Damage 8->6.

Bloody Storm: Skill Card -> Attack Card，
Consume all current energy, add x Boiling Blood cards into your hand.
-> Consume all current energy, deal x damage and add x Boiling Blood cards into your hand.

Transfusion: Discard your hand, then draw that many cards, and then draw 1 more.
-> Discard your hand, then draw that many cards.

Transfusion +: Discard your hand, then draw that many cards, and then draw 2 more.
-> Discard your hand, then draw that many cards, and then draw 1 more.

Poison Needle +: Deal 3 damage. Your next Attack card deals 1 additional damage.
-> Deal 2 damage. Your next Attack card deals 2 additional damage.

Resonance: Costs+1.

Suppressing Insect: Costs-1.
Suppressing Insect +: This card can choose an enemy in the middle row. 

Dark Pulse: Costs+1, Damage+2. 

UI Optimization
Added the monster overview UI.
You can see the card or prop when your mouse hover over the option of events.
You can click on the monster to see the card inside, the popup should stays displaying the cards it took.
Some UI details were optimized.

Fixed Balanced Strike doesn't gain damage bonus from Sharpening Stone.
Fixed few localization issues.

notes.title: V0.7.3 New Monsters, New Events, Balance Changes
notes.content:
4 elite monster has been added
[Fox] When dead, immediately end your current turn, and then take an extra turn.
[Iron Tree Essence] Frontline: Other enemies in the front row gain Iron Defense.
[Shaman Priest] Engage: Add 2 Weak cards into your life pile.
[Blood Hand] Range. Agile. Rebirth. Iron Defense.

4 new events have been added.

Balance Changes
All Out Swing:
    Upgrade: Damage+4 -> Upgrade: Damage+2

Rot:
    Upgrade: Damage+4 -> Upgrade: Damage+2

Shiv:
    Cost: 0 -> Cost: 1

Memory:
    Upgrade: Costs-1 -> Upgrade: Foresee+2

Meteor Shower:
    Deal 2 damage to a random enemy in the front row. This effect is repeated once for every 2 cards in your block pile.
-> Deal 2 damage to a random enemy in the front row. This effect is repeated once for every 3 cards in your block pile.

Red Flower:
     Every time you kill 10 enemies, gain 1 energy.
-> Every time you kill 8 enemies, gain 1 energy.

Blue Shield:
     After being attacked 10 times, gain immunity to the next attack.
-> After being attacked 8 times, gain immunity to the next attack.

Arrows:
    At the end of your turn, deal 2 damage to a random enemy in the middle row.
-> At the end of your turn, deal 3 damage to a random enemy in the middle row.

Thistles and Thorns:
    Whenever you are attacked for the first time each turn, dead 2 damage back.
-> Whenever you are attacked for the first time each turn, dead 3 damage back.

Plague Stick:
    At the end of your turn, if you have at 3 or more cards in your hand, deal 2 damage to all enemies in the front row.
-> At the end of your turn, if you have at 4 or more cards in your hand, deal 2 damage to all enemies in the front row.

Fixed Close Quarters not putting Boiling Blood cards into your hand.
